scope: Revalidate all four GTK2 scrollbar stepper directions in the current Theme Lab GTK2 renderer under DomainOS KDE roles, including normal, held, and release behavior after the R470/R473 update.

runtime.isolation: private Xvfb/bwrap fixture; personal HOME and system bus not exposed

held_released_asset_comparison.method: Reused the generated 15x15 GTK2 direction assets and current preview allocations. Each held full-window capture was compared against its matching pressed asset, with the other three direction cells compared against normal assets; each released full-window capture was compared against all four normal assets.

execution_note: The first harness invocation lacked its tests directory on PYTHONPATH and failed while importing the post-capture verifier; it produced no valid pixel result. After correcting the import path, the same isolated test passed. The incomplete owned fixture was preserved at ~/tempia/ia-tema/archived/I167-R480-failed-test-invocation-v1b45v32.
result: In the current generated GTK2 renderer, all four 15x15 cells matched their generated normal assets exactly. Each held capture matched its expected pressed cell and the other three normal cells in 0/225 differences; every released capture matched all four normal assets in 0/225. Holding each arrow changed 53 pixels. Dynamic DomainOS role colors matched in the fixture. This confirms the post-R470 source-renderer interaction path, not historical appearance in the SR10.4 guest.
limits: This is an isolated Theme Lab-generated GTK2 recipe, not a separately launched copy of the user-installed theme package or a personal GTK2 application.
No SR10.4 guest input was sent; Q499 coordination authorization remains unanswered.
The test does not prove the held horizontal appearance against a live VUE capture, disabled appearance, full application fidelity, or human acceptance.
next: Keep I167 focused on GTK2. Obtain the cursor-clear horizontal held-state comparison in the SR10.4 VM when the saved coordination gate permits it; use R480 as current post-R470 GTK2 renderer evidence.
